arrival_oxygen_debt.name: arrival_oxygen_debt

intrinsic_sinus_rate.name: intrinsic_sinus_rate

preload_fraction.name: preload_fraction
preload_fraction.rule: the authored small, underfilled LV with vigorous contraction (V_EVIDENCE) places arrival below the neutral position: from the deepest GI underfilling point (min of gi_reference.PRELOAD_BANDS, whose GI bands also read a collapsing IVC and are not transferred as such) up to the neutral position, midpoint the middle; the plethoric IVC and the raised JVP are right-sided observations and are not read (IVC_IS_NOT_UNIVERSAL_V_MAPPING); the magnitude is the faculty's

pulmonary_embolism_33f.presentation: A 33-year-old woman arrives with sudden breathlessness and sharp right-sided chest discomfort. She wonders whether anxiety could explain the episode; this has not been assessed.

truth.chest_xray: No focal consolidation, edema or pneumothorax.
truth.ctpa: Acute lobar and segmental filling defects in the right and left pulmonary arteries. Mild RV enlargement.
truth.diagnosis: Acute pulmonary embolism with hypoxemia, initially without hypotension
truth.extremities_exam: Unilateral calf swelling and tenderness on the operated side.
onset: The breathing and chest discomfort started abruptly about two hours ago.
truth.pocus_dvt_popliteal: Non-compressible on the operated (symptomatic) side, with echogenic intraluminal material; compressible on the other side
truth.pocus_rv: Mildly enlarged, approximately equal to the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
truth.respiratory_exam: Increased effort; breath sounds are equal without focal crackles or wheeze.

classes.definitive_actions: AUTHORED_CASE_TRUTH (faculty-declared definitive actions: anticoagulation, consult, oxygen)

pulmonary_embolism_61m.presentation: A 61-year-old man is brought in after nearly collapsing. He is breathless and says he feels faint even while lying on the trolley.

truth.cardiac_exam: Rapid regular pulse; elevated jugular venous pressure.
truth.chest_xray: No focal consolidation or pulmonary edema.
truth.ctpa: Extensive acute bilateral main and lobar pulmonary arterial filling defects with RV enlargement and septal flattening.
truth.diagnosis: High-risk pulmonary embolism with obstructive shock
truth.neurological_exam: Awake and answers appropriately, but reports persistent faintness.
onset: The severe breathlessness and near-collapse began about 45 minutes ago.
truth.pocus_dvt_popliteal: Left popliteal vein non-compressible; right popliteal vein compressible
truth.pocus_lv: Small, underfilled cavity with vigorous contraction
truth.pocus_rv: Larger than the LV; septal flattening with a D-shaped LV; reduced free-wall contraction with apical sparing (McConnell sign)
truth.respiratory_exam: Marked respiratory effort with equal breath sounds and no widespread crackles.

decided.collapse: P2M-2 exercised structurally; no thresholds; no arrest calibration
decided.d_lactate: arrival D a latent case state constrained by the authored physiology, never from lactate; common D / lactate kinetics not retuned; lactate never forced monotonic
decided.drive: P2P-2 exercised structurally: the hypoxaemic drive UNSET or SYNTHETIC_ONLY; no threshold, gain or curve from PE; no PE RR residual; central depression preserved; no opioid code
decided.g: direct G, never through L; no L_rev semantics on direct G; the common G -> SpO2 -> DO2 path; no G subtype; no PE oxygen-response function
decided.goal: a family migration on the closed common core; generalization over case fitting; a family mapping is acceptable where the disease mechanism has information the common channels do not hold
decided.l_owner: PE_L_ZERO_OWNER_AUTHORIZED: the PE family owns L (lung_water_authority) with zero intrinsic congestion generation unless a case independently authors pulmonary edema; it suppresses the provisional common overload writer; a family authority decision over the common L channel, not a derived equation
decided.no_double_count: the obstruction is never encoded as low V and low P at once without independent authored mechanisms
decided.no_sided_state: SIDED_PRELOAD_COMMON_STATE_DEFERRED: no RV / LV preload, RA / LA pressure, PCWP, sided P or sided V as common state
decided.one_owner: one authoritative L owner per run (P2O-3); two independent owners are never composed; common downstream L readers unchanged
decided.p2q1: TRUE_CROSS_FAMILY_CONFLICT accepted for the current unsided common congestion coupling, resolved for this migration by family authority
decided.preload: IVC_IS_NOT_UNIVERSAL_V_MAPPING: V (effective forward preload) from the authored small / underfilled LV; the plethoric IVC is RIGHT_SIDED / OBSERVATIONAL evidence, never common V
decided.tone_hr: no pressure -> tone compensation and no HR retuning (P2J not reopened); the gaps are recorded

verdict_criteria: PE arrival mapping coherent (arrival exact where the core models it; V from the underfilled LV, the IVC not read; L 0; pump reserve neutral; the secondary neutral)
obstructive / forward-flow failure uses existing channels cleanly (the writer writes P only; Q, MAP, DO2, the deficit and D follow in the common core; V, Hb and L untouched)
no V / P double counting (no PE source writes V or the blood state; the arrival position never changes the arrival; the V mapping reads only the LV)
PE owns L with zero generation (no common overload write, no L write; a second owner refused)
fluid stress creates no false L (every LV-band point; SpO2 and G unchanged by the fluid)
direct G path works (G linear, the common SpO2 mapping, delivery down, no L_rev credit)
oxygen response common (monotone in FiO2, attenuated as G worsens, no family oxygen function)
P2P-2 respiratory-drive architecture accepts hypoxaemia structurally (UNSET none, synthetic drives and grows; central depression still dominates)
D / lactate remain common (arrival D latent, never from lactate; lactate the core's; kinetics untouched)
collapse accepts the outputs structurally (signals rise, max holds, UNSET stays a lower bound, no family rule)
no prior family retuned (GI, ACS, pulmonary edema, P2P-2 reproduced; tone and HR gains untouched; every common file at its P2P-2 bytes; the P2P-2 tree proven)
design.verdict_rule: Predeclared. READY when every criterion holds; otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing criterion as the blocker. The HR, RR, consciousness and tone gaps, the lactate shape and the legacy differences are reported and never decide it
